IC1: Age equal or greater than 70 years
IC2: Onset of symptoms < 3 hours prior to randomisation
IC3: = 2 mm ST-elevation across 2 contiguous precordial leads (V1-V6) or leads I and aVL for a minimum combined total of = 4 mm ST-elevation or
IC4: = 2 mm ST-elevation in 2 contiguous inferior leads (II, III, aVF) for a minimum combined total of = 4 mm ST-elevation
